content.short: Founded in 2011 as BTC China, BTCC now runs perpetual futures with copy trading and demo accounts for practice.
content.description: BTCC started in 2011 as BTC China, which makes it one of the longest-running exchanges in the industry. Today it is a derivatives venue offering perpetual futures on BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP and many more, with very high maximum leverage. Copy trading lets newer users follow experienced traders, and demo accounts allow practice without real funds. BTCC is a regional partner of the Argentine Football Association. Futures are available in USDT, USDC and coin-margined forms, demo accounts come with 100,000 USDT in virtual funds, and the exchange has added zero-fee TradFi markets for metals, commodities, forex and stocks.
